battlecruiser.description: Big mana and large threats. Lower interaction, higher impact plays.
battlecruiser.primary_goal: Ramp into expensive threats and win through overwhelming board presence or combat.
preferred_card_patterns: search your library for a land
battlecruiser.engine_notes: Prioritize ramp that reaches the deck's most important high-cost plays.

stax.description: Restricts opponents' actions, resources, untaps, casting, or combat.
stax.primary_goal: Break parity on restrictive effects and win while opponents are slowed down.
avoid_patterns: symmetrical effects the deck cannot break
stax.engine_notes: Score stax cards higher only when the deck can function under its own restriction.

spellslinger.description: Built around casting instants, sorceries, and/or noncreature spells.
spellslinger.primary_goal: Generate value from repeated spell casts, copying spells, storm-like turns, or spell-trigger payoffs.
avoid_patterns: high creature count with no spell payoff
equipment focus unless commander supports it
spellslinger.engine_notes: Cheap spells that replace themselves score higher than expensive one-shot effects unless the deck has a cost reduction or free-cast engine.

control.description: Answers threats, manages the board or stack, and wins once stable.
control.primary_goal: Survive, trade efficiently, generate card advantage, and close with resilient win conditions.
control.engine_notes: Interaction should match color identity and expected threats; permanent-based interaction scores higher in permanent-recursion decks.

pillowfort.description: Discourages or prevents attacks while building a protected engine or alternate win condition.
pillowfort.primary_goal: Make attacking you inefficient, buy time, and win through protected engines.
avoid_patterns: group hug with no win plan
pillowfort.engine_notes: Defensive pieces need a clear win path; do not fill the deck with delay effects only.

voltron.description: Builds one primary threat with Equipment, Auras, counters, buffs, evasion, and protection.
voltron.primary_goal: Protect and scale one major threat, often the commander, to win through combat or commander damage.
voltron.engine_notes: Single-target buffs score high only when the commander or deck cares about individual power, damage, or safe attacks.

group_hug.description: Gives resources to the table while aiming for politics, protected engines, or hidden wins.
group_hug.primary_goal: Shape table behavior and prepare a win condition while giving shared resources.
preferred_card_patterns: at the beginning of each player's
avoid_patterns: giving resources without a win plan
hard stax unless user requests it
group_hug.engine_notes: The deck must have a clear way to profit more than opponents from shared resources.

group_slug.description: Punishes the table with symmetrical or opponent-focused damage, drain, discard, taxes, or resource pressure.
group_slug.primary_goal: Apply repeated pressure to all opponents and survive the backlash.
avoid_patterns: effects that hurt you more than opponents
group_slug.engine_notes: Score symmetrical effects based on whether the deck is built to survive or break parity.

reanimator.description: Uses graveyard setup and recursion to return important threats or value permanents.
reanimator.primary_goal: Put the right cards into the graveyard, then bring them back ahead of rate.
reanimator.engine_notes: Avoid graveyard exile unless it is a deliberate finisher or emergency meta answer.

mill.description: Wins by emptying opponents' libraries or using milled cards as a resource.
mill.primary_goal: Mill opponents consistently while surviving long enough to finish.
avoid_patterns: graveyard hate that shuts off your own payoffs
mill.engine_notes: If the deck uses opponents' graveyards as resources, avoid broad graveyard exile.

theft.description: Steals, copies, casts, or uses opponents' cards and resources.
theft.primary_goal: Scale with the strongest cards at the table by borrowing or copying them.
avoid_patterns: cards that depend on your own narrow tribe unless detail supports it
theft.engine_notes: Theft decks need flexible answers because the win condition depends on board state and opponents.

tribal.description: Built around a user-selected creature type and its internal synergies.
tribal.primary_goal: Use creature density, lords, type payoffs, and go-wide scaling to win.
avoid_patterns: tribal payoffs without enough tribe density
tribal.engine_notes: User detail must define the creature type. Do not hardcode specific tribes.

tokens.description: Creates many creature tokens and wins through mass buffs, sacrifice value, or combat.
tokens.primary_goal: Go wide and convert token volume into pressure, value, drain, or lethal swings.
avoid_patterns: single buffs unless commander wants individual power
tokens.engine_notes: Token makers score higher when the tokens are converted into damage, mana, cards, sacrifice value, or board pressure.

infect.description: Wins by applying poison counters through infect, toxic, combat, or proliferate.
infect.primary_goal: Apply poison counters early and finish through pump, evasion, proliferate, or repeated pressure.
avoid_patterns: slow battlecruiser with no poison support
infect.engine_notes: The first poison counter matters; proliferate is weak if the deck cannot reliably apply poison.

aristocrats.description: Sacrifices creatures and tokens for recurring value through death triggers, drain, or card advantage.
aristocrats.primary_goal: Build a sacrifice loop using outlets, fodder, and payoffs to drain opponents or generate overwhelming value.
avoid_patterns: large combat creatures with no synergy
high curve with no sacrifice payoff
aristocrats.engine_notes: Sacrifice outlets that are free or have low activation cost score higher than paid outlets.

combo.description: Assembles two or more cards that produce an infinite loop, overwhelming value, or an immediate win.
combo.primary_goal: Find and protect the combo pieces and win before opponents can interact.
avoid_patterns: slow battlecruiser with no combo synergy
win conditions that do not combo
combo.engine_notes: Combo pieces that are independently useful score higher than dedicated combo enablers with no standalone value.

stompy.description: Plays large efficient creatures and wins through combat pressure and raw power.
stompy.primary_goal: Deploy threats faster than opponents can answer them and close with combat damage.
avoid_patterns: low-power cheap cards with no ramp synergy
combo focus unless commander supports it
stompy.engine_notes: Ramp that specifically helps deploy the largest threats scores highest.

graveyard_value.description: Uses the graveyard as a persistent resource for card advantage, recursion, and value generation.
graveyard_value.primary_goal: Fill the graveyard deliberately and convert it into ongoing card advantage and repeated value.
avoid_patterns: broad exile graveyard effects unless asymmetrical
low creature count with heavy graveyard reliance
graveyard_value.engine_notes: Cards that self-sacrifice and recur generate more value than one-shot recursion spells.

artifacts.description: Uses artifacts as the primary engine for ramp, payoffs, recursion, and combo.
artifacts.primary_goal: Build a density of artifacts and convert them into advantage through payoffs, sacrifice loops, or combo.
avoid_patterns: off-artifact creatures unless they have artifact synergy
artifacts.engine_notes: Mana rocks that also have payoff potential score higher than purely passive rocks.

enchantress.description: Casts many enchantments and draws cards or generates value when enchantments enter or are cast.
enchantress.primary_goal: Maintain hand advantage through enchantress draw triggers and build an overwhelming board.
avoid_patterns: high creature count with no enchantment payoff
enchantress.engine_notes: Enchantments that also provide protection or evasion score higher in enchantress builds.

equipment.description: Equips key creatures with equipment to scale them up, protect them, and win through combat.
equipment.primary_goal: Build a toolbox of equipment to create the right threat for any situation.
equipment.engine_notes: Equipment that provides both offense and protection scores higher than pure offense.

auras.description: Enchants creatures with auras to make them big threats, protect them, or generate value.
auras.primary_goal: Build one or more large threats using auras, protect them, and win through combat.
auras.engine_notes: Auras that provide hexproof or indestructible as part of their effect score very high.

lands.description: Uses lands-matter effects, high land count, and land-based engines to win.
lands.primary_goal: Play many lands, generate value from every land drop, and close with land-powered finishers.
preferred_card_patterns: search your library for a land
avoid_patterns: non-land ramp with no land synergy
lands.engine_notes: Land count minimum should be 38. Extra land drops are more important than pure ramp.

landfall.description: Triggers landfall abilities by playing many lands, often multiple times per turn.
landfall.primary_goal: Maximize land drops to trigger landfall effects, build a board, and close with landfall payoffs.
preferred_card_patterns: search your library for a land
landfall.engine_notes: Land count minimum should be 38. Landfall cards that create tokens or draw cards score higher.

lifegain.description: Gains life repeatedly and converts it into cards, counters, tokens, drain, or alternate wins.
lifegain.primary_goal: Use life gain as a resource to fuel payoffs and outlast or drain opponents.
avoid_patterns: pure aggro with no lifegain synergy
lifegain.engine_notes: Repeatable lifegain sources score higher than one-shot life gain.

blink.description: Repeatedly exiles and returns permanents to reuse ETB effects, reset permanents, or loop value.
blink.primary_goal: Blink value permanents repeatedly to generate overwhelming advantage.
avoid_patterns: heavy artifact focus without ETB synergy
blink.engine_notes: ETB cards that produce immediate value (draw, removal, tokens) score higher than purely passive ETBs.

go_wide_aggro.description: Creates many small creatures and wins through combat with mass buffs, tokens, and go-wide pressure.
go_wide_aggro.primary_goal: Build a wide board quickly and convert numbers into lethal damage.
avoid_patterns: heavy control package unless commander supports it
go_wide_aggro.engine_notes: Haste enablers and mass pump effects score highest in go-wide builds.

go_tall_aggro.description: Scales one or a few large creatures through buffs, counters, or auras and wins through combat damage.
go_tall_aggro.primary_goal: Make one or two key threats extremely large and connect them for lethal damage.
go_tall_aggro.engine_notes: Evasion and protection for the main threat score very high.

value_engine.description: Generates ongoing card advantage and value to outlast and outresource opponents.
value_engine.primary_goal: Build self-sustaining value loops that generate more resources than opponents can answer.
value_engine.engine_notes: Engines that produce both cards and board presence score highest.
